    int res = 1;
    while (y) {
        if (y & 1) res = (ll)res * x % MOD;
        x = (ll)x * x % MOD;
        y >>= 1;
    }
    return res;

inline void add_mod(int &x, int y) {
    x += y;
    if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
}

inline void sub_mod(int &x, int y) {
    x -= y;
    if (x < 0) x += MOD;
}

void ifwt(int *a, int len) {

        for (int j = 0; j < len; j += i << 1)

    b[0] = 0;
